  "pros": [
    "Much easier to track payments and outstanding invoices than Excel.",
    "Automates professional invoice creation and sending.",
    "Provides a clear, centralized view of financial activity."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Initial setup and data migration took some time to understand.",
    "Finding specific reporting options can sometimes be tricky.",
    "Still learning some of the less frequently used features."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This administrative assistant found Xero to be a significant improvement over managing finances with Excel, especially for invoice management and payment tracking. The transition to a dedicated accounting platform brought much-needed efficiency and organization, though there was an expected learning curve during the initial months of use. The ease of creating and sending professional invoices was a particular highlight for their daily tasks."
